jobs.title: Political, Crisis & Litigation, Associate Consultant
jobs.reason: The candidate's exceptional academic background in International Relations and Politics aligns strongly with the role's focus on political and public policy analysis. They meet the minimum 12 months of experience through relevant student assistant roles involving research, data analysis, and policy reporting. While direct commercial consulting experience is a gap, their strong analytical, technical (Python, SPSS), and communication skills make them a highly competitive applicant for this Associate Consultant position.
